purpose: Form NFRA-1 relates to the classes of companies and bodies corporate governed by the National Financial Reporting Authority, whose auditors are subject to monitoring, enforcement, quality oversight, or investigation by the Authority.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Not stated in the Rules text
checklist: Verify if securities are listed on any stock exchange in India or outside India
Check if unlisted public company has paid-up capital of not less than rupees five hundred crores
Check if unlisted public company has annual turnover of not less than rupees one thousand crores
Check if unlisted public company has aggregate outstanding loans, debentures and deposits of not less than rupees five hundred crores as on 31st March of the immediately preceding financial year
Check if the entity is an insurance company, banking company, company engaged in the generation or supply of electricity, or governed by a special Act
Check if a reference has been made by the Central Government in public interest
Check if a body corporate incorporated or registered outside India is a subsidiary or associate company whose income or networth exceeds twenty per cent of the consolidated income or networth
